caption: The drawing depicts a single, round, metal bucket with two large, curved handles attached on opposite sides near the rim. The bucket has a slightly tapered shape, wider at the top and narrower at the base. The exterior of the bucket is rendered in shades of brown and yellow, suggesting a copper or brass material, with visible shading and texture to indicate its cylindrical form. The rim and the handles are outlined and highlighted to show their three-dimensional, sturdy construction, and the inside of the bucket is colored in a reddish-brown tone. Circular patterns are visible along the upper edge of the bucket near the rivets, contributing to a sense of metallic joinery. The background is plain and off-white, with no other objects or elements present.
title: Kettle
